egress.terms: Free and anonymous. NBIA REST API serves DICOM series zips with no key; CORS open.

tooling: NBIA Data Retriever + documented REST API (`services.cancerimagingarchive.net/nbia-api/services/v1/`), plus the `tcia-utils` Python package. Deposit side has no API. It is a quarterly-reviewed proposal form.
chaining: Read side is effectively unlimited and needs no account, so the fetch workload scales independently of any deposit relationship. Deposits: one collection per approval, unlimited collections per institution in principle.

limits.value: Applications are reviewed quarterly by the TCIA Advisory Group to assess their utility to the TCIA user community.

limits_note: Per-object-cap: one zip per DICOM series (tens of MB each). The archive is sharded by series, not by dataset. Retention: permanent, DOI per collection. Deposit is NOT self-serve: quarterly Advisory Group review, signed non-negotiable Data Submission Agreement, 'a few months' to complete.
